title: demo-parts — the demo gains its title and footer; nothing else moves (Sonnet)

set.request: ext/demo gains title and footer as options a demo page may pass, rendered where shell.js's render() already promises them; byte-identical for the 202 existing callers that pass neither
steps: read the brief and the plan's demo section
read shell.js, stage.js, demo.js, readme.md, doc/
add title + foot to shell.js render() and prototype defaults
add the two CSS rules to shell.css
show both parts once in the demo page's own page.js
crawl 20 callers + the demo page at 1280/3440, zero console errors
screenshot a demo with both parts at 1280 and 3440
set.outcome:
**ext/demo gains its title and footer.** `shell.js` render() adds two lines — `if (this.title) div.c("demo-shell-title", () => h3(this.title));` above the path, `if (this.foot) div.c("demo-shell-foot", this.foot);` under the whole band (a string or a function, both `append()` already handles) — and the prototype gains `title: "", foot: ""`. `shell.css` gains two rules in `@layer theme`, reusing existing tokens (`--gap-ramp`, `--subtle`) and the `.demo-note` caption look: no new colour, no new size. Shown once in [Shell](/framework/ext/demo/shell/)'s fourth example; noted in [readme.md](/framework/ext/demo/readme.md).

**Proof.** Crawled the ext/demo page, the Shell page, and 20 callers across framework/core, framework/styles, framework/ui, framework/ux and web/nav at 1280+3440 (48 loads): 0 new console errors — the 14 loads that do carry errors are pre-existing (confirmed by running the identical crawl against the original shell.js/shell.css swapped in, then restored byte-for-byte) and outside this slice's fence (a `this.words is not a function` bug in `styles/layouts/{split,flex,grid,document,overlay,landing,bold-editorial}/`, and `ux/Auth/`'s `demo.exhibit({})` calling `.demo()` on an undefined `page`). Pixel-diffed 3 callers (ui/alert, core/Page/overview/wall, styles/layouts/split) at both widths, original vs edited: all 6 screenshots byte-identical.
